questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how user-controlled values are sanitized before being placed in the notification email? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A message's messageUrl is "https://evil.example/login". What link appears in the email?
Why does the code strip control characters from the sender display name before using it in the subject?
choices: To keep CR/LF out of the subject so it cannot inject extra mail headers or break the header line
Because escapeHtml cannot handle non-ASCII characters
To make clampLength count characters correctly
Because control characters make the URL invalid

choices:
a
<b>hi</b>, a line break followed by the literal tags as text
